avoidsAhead.one: This route keeps away from the fire and from where it is expected to spread in the next hour.
avoidsAhead.other: This route keeps away from the fire and from where it is expected to spread in the next {count} hours.

route.avoidsBurned: This route keeps away from the area the fire has already burned.
route.warning: Warning: no route avoids the burned area.
route.none: No route that keeps away from the fire was found. Follow the instructions of the emergency services on site.
route.blocked: The usual route goes through a closed road, and no other route can be planned right now. Follow the instructions of the emergency services on site.

order.leave: The order for {zone} is to leave now for {destination}.
order.stay: The order for {zone} is to stay indoors until the emergency services say otherwise.

fire.noForecast: There is no forecast for this moment, so nothing is predicted for {zone}.
fire.noImpactMinutes: No predicted impact on {zone} in the next {count} minutes.

noImpactHours.one: No predicted impact on {zone} in the next {count} hour.
noImpactHours.other: No predicted impact on {zone} in the next {count} hours.

fire.covered: The predicted fire area already covers {zone}.
fire.reachesMinutes: The fire is predicted to reach {zone} in about {count} minutes.

reachesHours.one: The fire is predicted to reach {zone} in about {count} hour.
reachesHours.other: The fire is predicted to reach {zone} in about {count} hours.

call.endedWithoutRecord: The call ended without a recorded answer: call again.

sms.videoLink: Wildfire emergency: open this link to show the coordination your situation on video: {link}
sms.crewRoom: HackFire: the coordination is sharing its map with the crews. Join here: {link}

alert.one: Wildfire near {place}: the simulation expects it to arrive in about an hour. Follow the instructions of Civil Protection and 112.
alert.other: Wildfire near {place}: the simulation expects it to arrive in about {count} hours. Follow the instructions of Civil Protection and 112.

liveOps.alertSoon: Wildfire near {place}: the simulation expects it to arrive in less than an hour. Follow the instructions of Civil Protection and 112.
liveOps.alertDue: Wildfire near {place}: according to the simulation, it may already be arriving. Follow the instructions of Civil Protection and 112.

sources.safety_net: the safety net (the call ended with nothing recorded)

call.webStarted: Call with {name} started in the browser.

started.one: Calls to {zone} started: {count} call placed, {refused} refused.
started.other: Calls to {zone} started: {count} calls placed, {refused} refused.

alert.createdSms: Crew alert for {name}, being texted to the crew.
alert.createdDashboard: Crew alert for {name}, on the dashboard only.
alert.smsSent: Crew alert for {name} texted to the crew.
alert.smsFailed: The crew SMS for {name} failed: the alert stays on the dashboard.

added.one: Road closed at {place} ({radius} m): {count} resident was leaving through it.
added.other: Road closed at {place} ({radius} m): {count} residents were leaving through it.

video.linkTexted: Video link for {name} texted to the resident.
video.linkShown: Video link for {name} created, not texted (no SMS).

autopilot.off: Call simulation turned off: the state before it is back.

demo.reset: Demo reset: registry reloaded, orders, closures and calls cleared.

providers.checking: Still checking: no answer within {seconds} s.
providers.deepfireOff: The replay uses the cached hotspots.
providers.deepfireBusy: Busy (HTTP {code}): live mode keeps its last answer.
providers.orsQuota: Quota spent: using the cached routes.
providers.orsRate: Too many requests this minute: using the cached routes.
providers.orsDown: Not answering: using the cached routes.
providers.overpassNone: No mirror answers: the replay uses the cached places.
providers.slngNoAgent: The key works, but the resident agent was not found.
providers.twilioOff: Crew alerts stay on the dashboard.
providers.twilioNoCrew: No crew phone set: crew alerts stay on the dashboard.
providers.twilioOn: Configured (not tested: that would send a message).
providers.vonageOff: No live video or video-link SMS.
providers.vonageOn: Configured (not tested: that would send a message).
providers.vonageVideoOnly: Video configured, SMS not: links are shown, not texted.
